turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Hey Sam. Good to hear your voice after a long day. How did your shift at the store wrap up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, exhausting. We had floor resets and two call-outs, so I was running back and forth between the register and the stockroom all afternoon.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That sounds draining on your feet and your patience. Did any news come in while you were running around?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, yeah, I checked my email on my fifteen-minute break. Pellwick sent over the invite, so the final round is officially locked in for Monday, October twelfth.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: A final round is huge news. How are you feeling about having a few weeks to get ready?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A little bit of everything, honestly. It's great to have some breathing room, but part of me knows that means three weeks of sitting with the nerves.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: The waiting is always tricky. Did the recruiter mention what the format looks like?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, looks like a panel with their head of customer success and an account manager, followed by a live customer scenario.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Live scenarios play right into how you de-escalate problems on the floor every day. Do you want to dive into prep later this week or just rest tonight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Definitely taking tonight off. Maybe later this week we can dust off the onboarding checklist story and tighten it up a bit.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Resting first is smart. Were you able to get someone to cover your store hours for that Monday?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, my assistant manager already agreed to trade shifts with me, so I have the whole day cleared.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That takes off a lot of logistical pressure. What does relaxing look like for the rest of your evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Probably just leftover pasta and some trashy television with my cat on the couch.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That sounds like the exact right plan. Want to reconnect on Thursday evening to map out our practice schedule?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thursday evening works great for me. Talk to you then, Wren.
